subject: ela
intro: This test covers the whole Vocabulary Acquisition and Use cluster across all three standards: finding word meanings with clues, roots, affixes, and references (4.L.C.4), understanding figurative language and word relationships (4.L.C.5), and using precise academic and topic words (4.L.C.6). Each question is multiple choice and labeled with the standard it checks.

items.prompt:
Use context clues.

The sky grew dim as thick clouds hid the sun.

What does "dim" most likely mean?
A) Bright
B) Dark or not bright
C) Loud
D) Warm

steps: The clue is that "thick clouds hid the sun."
Without sunlight the sky gets darker.
So dim means not bright, answer B.

items.prompt:
Use the prefix.

The milk was so old it was undrinkable.

The prefix "un" means not and "able" means can be. What does "undrinkable" mean?
A) Very tasty
B) Not able to be drunk
C) Cold
D) Full
items.answer: B) Not able to be drunk

steps: Break the word: un (not) + drink + able (can be).
Put the parts together: not able to be drunk.
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) Not able to be drunk

items.prompt:
Use word parts.

The reporter sent a telegram to the newspaper office far away.

The root "tele" means far and "gram" means something written. What does "telegram" mean?
A) A written message sent over a long distance
B) A kind of camera
C) A loud sound
D) A drawing of a map
items.answer: A) A written message sent over a long distance

steps: Break the word: tele (far) + gram (something written).
Put the parts together: writing sent far away.
The context says it went to an office "far away," so A.
solution.answer: A) A written message sent over a long distance

items.prompt:
Multiple-meaning word.

The soldiers had to guard the fort against the coming attack.

Using the sentence, what does "guard" mean here?
A) A player on a basketball team
B) To protect or watch over something
C) A piece of a machine
D) To fall asleep
items.answer: B) To protect or watch over something

steps: "Guard" has several meanings.
The sentence is about soldiers protecting a fort from attack.
So guard means to protect or watch over, answer B.
solution.answer: B) To protect or watch over something

items.prompt:
Choose the antonym.

The turtle moved in a slow, lazy way across the yard.

Which word is an antonym for "slow"?
A) Quiet
B) Fast
C) Small
D) Green

steps: An antonym is the opposite.
"Slow" means not quick.
The opposite is "fast," answer B.

items.prompt:
Read the simile.

The old man's hands were as rough as sandpaper from years of hard work.

What does this simile mean?
A) His hands were very soft
B) His hands were rough and worn
C) His hands were clean
D) His hands were cold
items.answer: B) His hands were rough and worn

steps: The simile compares his hands to sandpaper using "as."
Sandpaper is rough.
So his hands were rough and worn, answer B.
solution.answer: B) His hands were rough and worn

items.prompt:
Read the idiom.

When I worried about the test, my friend said, "Don't bite off more than you can chew," and told me to study one part at a time.

What does this idiom mean?
A) Eat smaller bites of food
B) Do not take on more than you can handle
C) Chew your food slowly
D) Skip the test
items.answer: B) Do not take on more than you can handle

steps: This is an idiom with a hidden meaning.
The friend says to study "one part at a time."
It means do not try to do more than you can handle, answer B.
solution.answer: B) Do not take on more than you can handle

items.prompt:
Read the sentence.

The library was a treasure chest, holding thousands of stories waiting to be opened.

Which statement is correct?
A) It is a simile that means the library was empty
B) It is a metaphor that means the library was full of valuable stories
C) It is an idiom that means the library was closing
D) It is a proverb about saving money
items.answer: B) It is a metaphor that means the library was full of valuable stories

steps: There is no "like" or "as," so it is a metaphor.
The library is called "a treasure chest" of stories.
It means the library was full of valuable stories, answer B.
solution.answer: B) It is a metaphor that means the library was full of valuable stories

items.prompt:
Choose the precise verb.

"We won the championship!" ______ the whole team as they lifted the trophy.

Which word fits best?
A) whispered
B) cheered
C) mumbled
D) sighed

steps: The team is excited and "lifted the trophy."
"Cheered" means to shout with joy.
So the answer is B.

items.prompt:
Domain word.

The class studied how pollution harms the environment and what people can do to keep the air and water clean.

What does "environment" mean?
A) A kind of animal
B) The natural world around us, including air, water, and land
C) A type of building
D) A school subject only
items.answer: B) The natural world around us, including air, water, and land

steps: The clue is "keep the air and water clean."
The environment is the natural world around us.
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) The natural world around us, including air, water, and land

items.prompt:
Choose the precise verb.

"I, I am not sure I locked the door," ______ Kim, worried she had forgotten.

Which word fits best?
A) stammered
B) announced
C) laughed
D) commanded

steps: The clue is the repeated "I, I" and that Kim was "worried."
"Stammered" means to speak with nervous pauses and repeats.
So the answer is A.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

Only a few of these giant turtles remain, so scientists list them as endangered and work hard on conservation to keep them from vanishing.

Which answer best explains BOTH underlined ideas, "endangered" and "conservation"?
A) Endangered means common, and conservation means using something up
B) Endangered means at risk of dying out, and conservation means protecting nature
C) Endangered means healthy, and conservation means building cities
D) Endangered means fast, and conservation means a kind of turtle
items.answer: B) Endangered means at risk of dying out, and conservation means protecting nature

steps: "Only a few... remain" shows the turtles could die out, so endangered means at risk of dying out.
Scientists "keep them from vanishing," so conservation means protecting nature.
So the answer is B.
solution.answer: B) Endangered means at risk of dying out, and conservation means protecting nature
